verdict.rationale: Databricks documents OpenSharing as a secure data sharing platform for sharing data and AI assets with users outside your organization, even if they don't use Databricks. It also documents a Marketplace where providers publish dataset listings that consumers connect to directly from their workspace, which covers the core of cross-organization sharing without building an export pipeline. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that shared data stays live and is not copied or replicated, details on cross-account or cross-cloud mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
